title: kubecon-2026-vendor-contacts-expense-scratchpad
content:
Quick notes / checklist for KubeCon SF 2026 travel (working scratchpad)

-- HIGH-LEVEL TODOs --
- Finalize attendee list and confirm travel approvals (ops/finance)
- Collect receipts daily during trip (phone photos) and tag in Expensify with attendee name + GL code
- Submit expense reports within 30 days of return (finance policy)

-- Attendees (draft) --
- Samantha Lee (owner) — presenting on SRE inference autoscaling
- Alex Martinez — booth lead
- Jordan Kim — solutions eng (customer meetings)
- Olivia Park — ops support (hardware logistics)

-- Vendor & logistics quick contacts --
- Hotel: Moscone Grand (example hotel)
  - Front desk: +1 415-555-0199
  - Group reservations: group-sales@mosconehotels.example.com
  - Booking refs: SAMLEE-9201, REDWOOD-BOOTH-77 (still pending confirmation)
- Booth builder: ExpoWorks Co.
  - Primary: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@expoworks.example.com>
  - Phone: +1 213-555-0142
  - On-site lead: Carlos (cell +1 415-555-0220) — confirm booth power specs by 2026-02-25
- AV vendor: StageLight Rentals
  - Contact: Priya Nair <priya@stagelight.example.com>
  - Tech lead: onsite@stagelight.example.com
  - NOTE: order 2 x 4K monitors, HDMI extenders, 1 mic input for demo laptop
- Shipping/Logistics: RapidShip Logistics
  - Account rep: Helen Cho <helen@rapidship.example.com>
  - Tracking: request door-to-booth delivery, insure equipment $25k
- Catering (reception): TinyBites Catering
  - Contact: orders@tinybites.example.com
  - Need vegetarian/gluten-free options clearly labeled

-- Expense reminders & categories --
- Per diem policy: $65/day meal cap for SF (follow finance table) — keep itemized receipts
- Air: economy or economy-plus for IC/SE; business allowed if >8hr flight and pre-approved (use GL: TRVL-AIR)
- Hotel: use conference negotiated rate where possible (GL: TRVL-HOTEL)
- Ground: rideshare receipts accepted (include tip), taxi receipts need vendor name + amount
- Booth spend: materials, shipping, AV, furniture (GL: EVENTS-BOOTH)
- Meals with customers: list attendee names and company on receipt (GL: TRVL-MEAL-CUST)
- Misc (parking, tolls): keep photo of receipts, small cash receipts scan

-- Reimbursement process (quick) --
1) Upload receipts to Expensify under Redwood Inference account.
2) Tag report with event name = "KubeCon 2026" and travelers' full names.
3) Assign GL codes as above (contact finance if unsure).
4) Submit and request expedited review if reimbursement required before month-end payroll cycle.

-- Helpful internal links / refs --
- Travel policy (finance): Confluence link in linked_artifacts above
- Booth build plan (Design repo): GH PR #448 (link in event doc)
- Demo laptop image and credentials: DRIVE/secure (ask IT for temporary account)

-- Notes / open questions --
- Do we have a dedicated booth wifi? Expo usually sells but need to confirm speed and static IP requirements for demo. Action: Alex to confirm with ExpoWorks by 2026-02-20.
- Confirm shipping insurance amount with RapidShip (Helen). Action: Samantha to approve $25k by 2026-02-18.
- AV power draw: ensure booth power order includes 1200W circuit for GPUs + monitors. Action: Jordan to send power list to StageLight.

-- Day-of checklist (on-site) --
- Bring printed contact sheet (1 per attendee) + phone numbers
- Extra chargers, USB-C hubs, adapters, ethernet dongles
- Label all equipment with asset tags and return shipping labels
- Confirm booth layout and demo flow with onsite lead at T-2 hours

-- Quick expense tips (from past events) --
- Scan receipts immediately and put a note (who/why) — makes finance happy
- If paying with company card, note personal items and reimburse promptly
- For group dinners: ask vendor for separate checks or itemized receipt to avoid split headaches

-- Scratch/notes to self --
- Slack channel to use during event: #kubecon-2026 (create if not exists)
- Bring spare SD card for recordings (label with date)
- Check passport/ID for any traveling non-US staff (copy to secure drive)

-- End of scratchpad --

(Will iterate with Alex/Jordan/Olivia — drop notes here as things get confirmed)
summary: Scratchpad for KubeCon 2026: vendor contacts, expense reminders, checklist and open actions
